purpose: Define 1000 non-compensable essentials for the complete Skeleton AI platform so advanced capability, self-improvement or benchmark gains cannot conceal missing engineering, safety, reliability, operability, data, AI-runtime or human-control fundamentals.

relationship.relation_to_psi: Each ESS1000-nnnn is paired to PSI1000-nnnn. An unresolved essential in an affected domain outranks optional PSI optimization, and PSI finality cannot compensate for ESS-1000 incompleteness.

laws: Every ESS-1000 level is mandatory for the complete Skeleton platform; no advanced feature, benchmark gain, model capability or self-improvement score may compensate for a missing essential.
Documentation, design intent, generated plans and passing unrelated tests never count as implementation evidence.
The minimum reliable mechanism is preferred to clever optional complexity at the essential layer.
Unknown authority, identity, scope, security, privacy, durability, recovery or evidence state fails closed.
A disabled optional capability still requires a safe disabled-state contract; platform closure may not use not-applicable labels to erase control-path obligations.
Every essential has explicit failure semantics, regression coverage, observability and recovery/rollback behavior where applicable.
Every completion claim binds to an exact implementation identity and current independently reproducible evidence.
Stale evidence revokes dependent essential qualification.
An open essential gap in a PSI-affected domain has scheduling priority over cosmetic or optional self-improvement in that domain.
ESS1000-1000 cannot self-attest and requires whole-system independent reproduction.

psi_priority_bridge.scheduling_rule: If an ESS level is unresolved and its paired PSI opportunity is eligible, the scheduler must classify essential closure or regression repair above optional polish for the affected domain unless a more severe non-compensable incident elsewhere overrides it.
psi_priority_bridge.promotion_rule: PSI evidence may satisfy shared factual tests but cannot itself mark the paired ESS level complete; ESS requires its own closure signature and independent evidence.
psi_priority_bridge.finality_rule: PSI-1000 project finality may not be used as evidence that ESS-1000 platform finality is complete.

completion.rule: ESS-1000 qualifies only when all 1000 levels are simultaneously signed_complete on current independent evidence and ESS1000-1000 has whole-system finality reproduction.

levels.title: Mission & Product Intent — Essential Invariant & Minimum

levels.essential_contract: For mission, user value, boundaries, non-goals, stakeholders and measurable outcomes, define the irreducible minimum, protected invariant, ownership, scope, forbidden shortcuts and the exact condition that would constitute a missing essential. dependency_topology.model: 99 parallel essential-domain lanes plus one whole-system finality lane
dependency_topology.domain_lane_rule: For ESS-S001..ESS-S099, stage 1 has no artificial predecessor and stages 2..10 depend only on the preceding stage in the same stratum.
dependency_topology.finality_lane_rule: ESS-S100 begins only after the stage-10 closure gate of all 99 preceding strata is current; its remaining stages then execute sequentially.
dependency_topology.rationale: Non-compensable does not mean globally serialized. Independent essentials may be implemented and verified in parallel, while whole-system finality waits for every domain closure.
